items.summary: Reviewer disposition: reject all new admissions and duplicate evidence work this cycle. Preserve existing repair, measurement, readiness, security-matrix, and private-gate work only. CTO must complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair and release one slot by 2026-10-01T09:00Z; only then may the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement proceed with existing telemetry, tests, metric, and rollback.

Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA request as slot-gated only; its 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission are an operating baseline, not proof of revenue or ROI. First complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case with root cause, validation, rollback, and release-boundary evidence, then release one slot.

Continue the existing private launch-gate evidence work only. Reject the proposed duplicate legal proposal; no new proposal, outreach, launch, affiliate, advertising, or remarketing action is authorized. Close no task without direct dated evidence and human-counsel escalation where required.

Continue the existing security evidence matrix and private-exposure gate without creating duplicate work items or requesting duplicate telemetry. Preserve unknowns; do not claim certification, compromise, or clearance from missing fleet-doctor and operations evidence.

Reject all new implementation admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 active slots, with 54 improvements measuring, 21 failed requests, and 7 repair follow-ups. No candidate can be safely routed without displacing existing work. Preserve containment-only execution; do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, or causal lift. CTO must complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case and release one slot by 2026-10-01T09:00Z; unresolved capacity must be escalated to the owner by that deadline. After release, admit only the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement.

Do not create or requeue implementation requests while active delivery remains 10/10. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case with root cause, isolated validation, build evidence, rollback point, and release/security boundary by 2026-10-01T09:00Z. If unresolved, escalate to the owner by that deadline. The next admissible change is the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement, subject to the recorded baseline, tests, metric, and rollback.
